reason: Implementation defect found when `holdout --confirm` first ran on 2026-11-05: merge.tml_match refused every TML row whose `sealed` flag was set, including held-out rows correctly unlocked by the frozen protocol, so the command stopped while assembling its first held-out match. No held-out output was printed, scored, or written. The rehearsal had not exercised this path because its January-May 2026 rows were never sealed.
fix: merge.tml_match now refuses only rows without a winner column (the sealed view); a regression test checks that an unlocked held-out row converts and a sealed row is still refused. phase4_experiment gains this amendment record and its check. No model, feature, parameter, dataset, input file, or protocol value changed.
results_seen_before_the_fix: the retrospective check (2024-May 2026) only; no held-out result
